title: Health Experts Seek New Ways to Identify and Treat Obesity
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: A group of international experts is proposing a new way to define and identify obesity – a medical condition linked to having too much body fat.
sentences.zh: 一个国际专家小组正在提出一种新的方法来界定和识别肥胖症,这是一种与身体脂肪过大有关的医疗状况。

sentences.en: The change aims to help doctors better identify and treat affected individuals.
sentences.zh: 改革的目的是帮助医生更好地识别和治疗受影响的个人。

sentences.en: The new proposal shifts attention from a highly debated method called the body mass index (BMI).
sentences.zh: 新提案将注意力从一种辩论激烈的方法转移开来,即身体质量指数。

sentences.en: BMI is a calculation of a person’s height and weight.
sentences.zh: BMI是一个人身高和体重的计算。

sentences.en: The change would mean BMI would no longer be the only way to define obesity.
sentences.zh: 改变意味着BMI不再是界定肥胖的唯一方法。

sentences.en: The method would be expanded to include other measurements, such as waist size, and other evidence of health problems linked to being overweight.
sentences.zh: 该方法将扩大,以包括其他测量,如腰部尺寸,以及与超重有关的健康问题的其他证据。

sentences.en: Obesity is estimated to affect more than 1 billion people worldwide.
sentences.zh: 据估计,肥胖影响到全世界10亿多人。

sentences.en: In the U.S., about 40 percent of adults are considered obese, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国,大约40%的成年人被认为肥胖,美国。

sentences.en: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says.
sentences.zh: 疾病控制与预防中心指出:

sentences.en: Dr. David Cummings of the University of Washington was one of 58 writers of a report calling for a new obesity definition.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿大学的David Cummings博士是一份呼吁制定新肥胖定义的报告的58个作者之一。

sentences.en: The report recently appeared in the publication The Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology .
sentences.zh: 该报告最近出现在出版物《柳叶刀糖尿病和内分泌学》中。

sentences.en: “The whole goal of this is to get a more precise definition so that we are targeting the people who actually need the help most,” Cummings told The Associated Press.
sentences.zh: Cummings对美联社说:「整件事的目的, 就是要有更精确的定义,

sentences.en: The report introduces two new groups, called categories, to help doctors identify, or diagnose, obese individuals.
sentences.zh: 报告介绍了两个称为类别的新群体,以帮助医生识别或诊断肥胖者。

sentences.en: These are clinical obesity and pre-clinical obesity.
sentences.zh: 这些是临床肥胖症和临床前肥胖症。

sentences.en: People with clinical obesity meet BMI and other markers of obesity.
sentences.zh: 患有临床肥胖症的人满足BMI和其他肥胖症的标志。

sentences.en: They also have evidence of organ, tissue or other problems caused by too much weight.
sentences.zh: 他们也有器官、组织或过重引起的其他问题的证据。

sentences.en: Such evidence could include heart disease, high blood pressure, liver or kidney disease or ongoing knee or hip pain.
sentences.zh: 这种证据可包括心脏病、高血压、肝脏或肾脏疾病或持续膝盖或臀部疼痛。

sentences.en: People identified as having clinical obesity would be able to get treatments, including diet and exercise programs, as well as obesity medications.
sentences.zh: 被确认患有临床肥胖症的人可以获得治疗,包括饮食和运动方案以及肥胖症药物。

sentences.en: People with pre-clinical obesity are at risk for the same conditions, but they have no ongoing illness, the report states.
sentences.zh: 报告指出,临床前肥胖症患者在同样条件下面临风险,但他们没有持续患病。

sentences.en: BMI has long been considered a weak measure for obesity.
sentences.zh: 长期以来,BMI被认为是肥胖症的薄弱措施。

sentences.en: In some cases, it can incorrectly diagnose obesity, which is currently defined as a BMI of 30 or more.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下,它可以错误地诊断肥胖症,目前将肥胖症定义为30或以上。

sentences.en: But people with too much body fat do not always have a BMI above 30, the report notes.
sentences.zh: 但是,报告指出,身体脂肪过大的人并不总有超过30的BMI。

sentences.en: And people with a high level of muscle mass — such as American football players or other athletes — may have a high BMI even with normal fat mass.
sentences.zh: 肌肉质量高的人,例如美国足球运动员或其他运动员, 可能拥有很高的BMI, 即使有正常的脂肪质量。

sentences.en: Under the new definitions, about 20 percent of people who used to be identified as obese would no longer meet that definition, early data suggests.
sentences.zh: 根据新的定义,大约20%曾经被确定为肥胖的人将不再符合该定义,早期的数据表明。

sentences.en: And about 20 percent of people with serious health effects – but a lower BMI – would now be considered clinically obese.
sentences.zh: 大约20%的有严重健康影响的人 — — 但体重指数较低 — — 现在被视为临床肥胖症。

sentences.en: Cummings said the new definition would not greatly change the percentage of people defined as having obesity.
sentences.zh: Cummings说,新定义不会大大改变被界定为肥胖者的百分比。

sentences.en: But, he explained, the new categories “would better diagnose the people who really have clinically excess fat.” More than 75 medical organizations around the world have supported the new definitions.
sentences.zh: 但是,他解释说,新的类别“将更好地诊断那些在临床上确实超脂肪的人 ” 。 全世界超过75个医疗组织支持了这些新定义。

sentences.en: But it is not clear how widely or quickly the definitions could be approved.
sentences.zh: 但是,不清楚这些定义在多大程度上可以广泛或迅速地得到核准。

sentences.en: The report predicts such changes would carry big costs and have major effects on the workforce.
sentences.zh: 报告预测,这些变化将带来巨大的成本,并对工作人员队伍产生重大影响。

sentences.en: Dr. Katherine Saunders is an obesity expert at Weill Cornell Medicine in New York City.
sentences.zh: Katherine Saunders博士是纽约市Weill Cornell医学的肥胖专家

sentences.en: She also co-founded the obesity treatment company FlyteHealth.
sentences.zh: 她还共同创办了肥胖治疗公司Flyte Health。

sentences.en: She told the AP there are some practical issues to consider in order to make the proposed changes work effectively.
sentences.zh: 她告诉亚太议会,为了使拟议的修改有效发挥作用,有些实际问题需要考虑。

sentences.en: Saunders noted that waist circumference sounds simple, but measurement methods differ.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯指出,腰围听起来很简单,但测量方法不同。

sentences.en: In addition, doctors are trained differently, and standard medical measuring devices are not big enough for many obese people.
sentences.zh: 此外,医生受到不同的培训,对许多肥胖者来说,标准医疗测量设备不够大。

sentences.en: Also, a decision about the difference between clinical and pre-clinical obesity would require a full health examination and lab tests, Saunders said.
sentences.zh: Saunders说,关于临床和临床前肥胖的区别的决定还需要进行全面的健康检查和实验室测试。

sentences.en: She added that for a new system to be widely accepted, “it would also need to be extremely quick, inexpensive, and reliable ."
sentences.zh: 她补充说,要使新系统得到广泛接受,“它也需要非常快、便宜和可靠。

sentences.en: The new definitions could also be difficult for people to understand or carry out, said Kate Bauer of the University of Michigan School of Public Health. “The public likes and needs simple messages.
sentences.zh: 密歇根大学公共卫生学院的Kate Bauer说,新的定义对人们来说也可能是难以理解或执行的。

sentences.en: I don’t think this differentiation is going to change anything,” she said.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种差异不会改变任何事。

sentences.en: Dr. Robert Kushner, of the Northwestern Feinberg School of Medicine, said changing the definition of obesity will take some time.
sentences.zh: 北西芬堡医学院的罗伯特·库什纳博士说,改变肥胖的定义需要一些时间。

sentences.en: Kushner, a co-writer of the report, said, “This is the first step in the process...I think it’s going to begin the conversation .” I’m John Russell.
sentences.zh: 这份报告的共同作者库什纳(Kushner)说 : “ 这是这个过程的第一步......我想它要开始对话了。 ”我是约翰·罗素。

sentences.en: Jonel Aleccia reported on this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: Jonel Aleccia为美联社报导此事。

sentences.en: John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: John Russell改编了它 用于VOA学习英语。
